description:
Create a file-based Shapefile directory datastore and publish layers. 

1. Copy the Natural Earth shapefiles from the host directory `/home/ga/natural_earth/` into the GeoServer Docker container (`gs-app`) at path `/opt/geoserver/data_dir/shp_data/`. You will need to create the directory first.

2. Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!).

3. Create a new workspace named `shp_ne` with URI `http://shp_ne.example.org`.

4. Create a new Store in `shp_ne` of type 'Directory of spatial files (shapefiles)' named `shp_directory` that points to the data you copied (`file:data/shp_data`).

5. Publish two layers from this store: `ne_110m_admin_0_countries` (title: 'Countries (Shapefile)') and `ne_110m_lakes` (title: 'Lakes (Shapefile)'). Ensure SRS is EPSG:4326 and bounding boxes are computed.

6. Verify the layers work by saving a WMS GetMap image for each layer to `/home/ga/countries_map.png` and `/home/ga/lakes_map.png` respectively.
